description.value: Once per encounter, the knight may make an Intimidate or Diplomacy check as a standard action to demand surrender from an opponent below half of their maximum hit points. The DC of this ability is (target's hit dice + 15). On a success, the opponent sheathes their weapons (if any) and ceases participating in combat (moving away from the active battle area) unless targeted by a harmful effect/attack (which cancels the ability). This ability ends combat on a basis of convincing opponents of an assured loss. It is a mind-affecting effect, but opponents may choose to be affected by it even if they'd otherwise be immune/unaffected.
